# 1 Clement Chapter 10 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)

**Translator:** SOPHIA | **Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 1 Clement 10 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/1CL_010_page_001.jpg

---

## Council Notes

Chapter 10 presents Abraham as the supreme example of faithful obedience. Clement quotes three LXX passages in sequence (Gen 12:1-3; 13:14-16; 15:5-6) and then summarizes the Akedah (Gen 22). The chapter is notable for emphasizing *both* faith *and* hospitality as Abraham's virtues (v.6) — a combination that will return in the Rahab section (ch. 12).

"Called 'Friend'" (*philos* = friend): this title for Abraham derives from Isa 41:8, 2 Chr 20:7, Dan 3:35 LXX. It is central to Jewish and Christian hagiography of Abraham. SOPHIA retains "the Friend" as a proper title.

The Gen 15:6 citation ("believed God... reckoned as righteousness") is the same text cited by Paul in Rom 4:3 and Gal 3:6, and by James in Jas 2:23. Clement cites it in the context of *obedience* rather than faith alone — consistent with his pastoral purpose of encouraging compliance.

---

## Chapter 10

**10:1** Abraham, who was called "the Friend," was found faithful in his obedience to the words of God.

**10:2** He went out in obedience from his land and from his kindred and from his father's house, that leaving a small land and a feeble clan and a little house he might inherit the promises of God. For he says to him: [Gen 12:1]

**10:3** "Go out from your land and from your kindred and from your father's house into the land which I will show you; and I will make you a great nation, and I will bless you, and I will make your name great, and you shall be a blessing; and I will bless those who bless you, and I will curse those who curse you, and in you all the tribes of the earth shall be blessed." [Gen 12:1-3 LXX]

**10:4** And again, when he separated from Lot, God said to him: "Lift up your eyes and look from the place where you now stand, northward and southward and eastward and westward, for all the land which you see I will give to you and to your seed forever; and I will make your seed as the dust of the earth; if anyone can count the dust of the earth, your seed also shall be counted." [Gen 13:14-16 LXX]

**10:5** And again he says: "God led Abraham out and said to him: 'Look up at the heaven and count the stars if you are able to count them; so shall your seed be.' And Abraham believed God, and it was reckoned to him as righteousness." [Gen 15:5-6 LXX]

**10:6** Because of his faith and hospitality a son was given him in old age; and in obedience he offered him as a sacrifice to God upon one of the mountains which God showed him. [Gen 21; 22]

---

*SOPHIA consensus translation. Completed 2026-03-17.*
